### Files

All next to `GDCompare.asi`: `x64\` on Windows, `compat/` for Steam's Compatibility Mode.

- [ ] `GDCompare.log`. It is overwritten each time the game starts, so attach it before starting the game again.
- [ ] A snapshot: in game, with the affected character loaded, press F9 and attach the newest `snapshots/snapshot-*.json`. For a wrong score, hover the item right before pressing F9: the snapshot records it.
- [ ] Optional: a screenshot of the tooltip with Shift held, if the problem is a score or how the block looks.
